info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Behavior Insights API
info.description: The Customer Behavior Insights API enables businesses to analyze and gain valuable insights into customer interactions within the banking sector. By aggregating and processing data related to customer behaviors, this API helps organizations understand trends, preferences, and engagement patterns. Typical consumers include financial institutions looking to enhance their customer relationship management strategies or optimize product offerings based on behavioral data. Utilize this API to drive informed decision-making and personalized customer experiences.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to generate comprehensive insights into customer behaviors by analyzing their interaction data. It serves as a vital tool for enhancing customer experience and tailoring marketing strategies.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update customer behavior insights. It expects a JSON object that includes various attributes related to customer interactions and behaviors. Ensure that the required fields are included to successfully process the request.
